name: Bajaj Auto Limited
remarksWeb: 1.  �Late Anant Bajaj, who was a promoter and/or was a person belonging to the promoter group of the Company died on 10th August 2018. The Late Anant Bajaj held 41,464 equity shares in Bajaj Auto Ltd., constituting 0.01 % of the paid-up equity share capital of the Company. nIn accordance with Regulation 31A(6)(c) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Late Anant Bajaj has automatically ceased to be a    promoter/person belonging to the promoter group on his death.  However, in consideration of the application made to the Hon�ble High Court, Bombay for grant of Letter of Administration in favour of his legal heirs namely, his wife, son and mother, who are already part of promoter/person belonging to the promoter group, the shares that were held by the Late Anant Bajaj are being continued to be classified as promoter shareholding. Upon the transmission, succession or inheritance of the shares that were held by the Late Anant Bajaj, the recipients of the shares will be classified as a promoter/person belonging to the promoter group, as applicable. Hence there will not be any change in the total promoter shareholding in the Company.�nn2. Following family trust of Promoters with NIL holding have been included in promoter group from this quarter-nAryaman Family Trust and Nirvaan Family Trust.
